subject: general
question: The Council of States shall consist of ______ members to be nominated by the President.
solution:
The correct answer is__** twelve.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Council of States** shall consist of** twelve members** to be nominated by the **President.**
 
• The Council of States is one of the two houses of the Indian Parliament, the other being the **Lok Sabha.**
 
• The members of the Council of States, also known as **Rajya Sabha,** are elected by the **elected members** of the Legislative Assemblies of States and Union territories.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **lower house of India's bicameral Parliament **is known as the Lok Sabha, or **House of the People** according to its constitution.
 
• Members of the Lok Sabha are chosen to represent their respective constituencies by **adult universal suffrage** and a first-past-the-post system, and they serve for **five years** or until the body is dissolved by the** President **on the recommendation of the council of ministers.
 
• The Indian Constitution limits the number of members of the **House to 552 **(up from 500 at first in 1950).
 
• The house currently has **543 seats,** which are filled by up to **543 elected members. **
